spec.timeframe: Observed 15m candles only; no inferred one-minute bars or maker fills
spec.scalp_breakout: Close above prior four-bar high, EMA20 above EMA60, volume ratio >=1
spec.scalp_reversion: 20-bar z-score <=-1.5, RSI14 <=40, close above previous close
spec.scalp_pullback: EMA20 above EMA60, previous close at/below previous EMA20, current close above EMA20
spec.blend: All three signal families share one account; one position per pair
spec.turnover_control: Enter each consecutive eligible closed bar; diagnostic churn, not a proposed strategy
spec.target: 0.50% target; 0.50% stop; four-bar maximum hold, control one bar; no trailing
spec.allocation: Long only, full cash notional reservation, 1% risk, existing shared-account limits
spec.timing: 64 consecutive observed bars warm-up; signal fills only on next observed adjacent bar
spec.costs: Current Kraken taker tiers vs hypothetical 0.10% per side vs zero-cost control; no maker-fee claim
spec.cost_guard: Sub-cost targets explicitly permitted only in research to measure their loss; defaults elsewhere retained

formation_universe.limitation: Selection uses formation data only; published-archive omissions can still introduce survivorship bias. Later missing members do not remove an asset.

limitations: Reused January–June development data; March–June account window, not untouched validation.
15m candles cannot establish one-minute scalping, quote depth, queue priority, latency or hundreds of realizable fills.
Current fee schedules are applied as present-cost sensitivities, not reconstructed historical fee schedules.
Hypothetical lower/zero costs are diagnostics on Kraken prices, not executable venue results.
Market-trigger fills only; intrabar order is unknown, simultaneous stop/target uses stop first.
Existing drawdown and daily-loss halts remain; no leverage, broker orders or paper-entry resumes.
Original 24 formation-selected assets retained; historical venue minimum quantities and execution depth not reconstructed.
